notes.title: Early Access - Version 1.4.0
notes.notes:
New Game Mode Added: Redacted
    Introduced the Grandma's Redacted Cameras level.

Consumables & Purchasables
     Sanity Pills added: Costs 10 Anomaly Dust and Restores 10 Sanity when consumed.

Leaderboard Update
     Expanded to show up to 1,000 players.
         Shows your position and lifetime anomalies.
         Shows total anomalies scanned by the community.

Bug Fixes
     Resolved an issue with 24-hour time display.
     Fixed a loading screen bug.

Optimizations
      Adjusted texture sizes across the game for improved build size and performance.

notes.title: Early Access - Version 1.3.3
notes.notes:
Inventory System Added
- Inventory is only in game at the moment, will later be viewable in main menu as well.
- You can access with "I" or button next to sanity bar.

Updated Trick or Treat / Halloween Pack
- This year you can collect candies and use them when you want.
- Candies on use will regain 10 sanity!

Other
- Pair of Eyes Anomaly Pack Added.
- Tooltip Bug Fixed
- Optimized Textures and meshes, cutting the game size in half!

notes.title: Early Access - Version 1.3.0
notes.notes:
- New Map "Asylum "
- New Gamemode "Custom"
- Changed sanity drain delay from 10 - 15 for "Lights out" Challenge.

notes.title: Early Access - Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
- New Save System
- Stats and Stat Tracking (Located in profile)
- Added Sanity Drain Delay 
     5 in-game Minutes for Normal
     10 in-game Minutes for "Lights out" Challenge
- Online Game Services
     Cloud Backup
     Leaderboard
- New Feature : Challenges
     First Challenge Added "Lights out"
- Anomaly Pack "Shadows" Reworked
- New Options Settings
     Added Low/Med/High Graphics Settings
     Added Camera Switch Arrows UI (Disabled by default)
- Localization System Added for Future Use
- Added Replay Button at End Game Screen

notes.title: Early Access - Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
- New Map !  "Prison"

notes.title: Early Access - Version 1.0.11
